# Captured argument value diagnostic

Capture only existing argument-freeze assignments and actual caller check
commands while translating the call. Selected variants project those same
checks through the existing typed binding equalities, reusing the already
computed value AST objects. Keep all argument evaluations, preparation, support,
complete summaries, call interfaces, metadata, other commands and transfers.

Reject changed source values, unsupported call-local effects and binder capture.
Native controls compute their projected fingerprint without constructing ASTs.
Actual selected expressions must equal that complete lexical projection, with
the original full attributes retained. Require genuine false-entry controls.
No reevaluation, extra proof, body/context-term collection, new axiom, fuel or
publication policy, raised ceiling, batching change or product adoption occurs.

The pass runs before Boogie type inference. It compares the frozen assignment target with its declared local type and rejects a differing known RHS type. An unset RHS type is recorded explicitly and is checked by the unchanged normal Boogie resolution/typechecking pipeline. All original assignments remain byte-for-byte represented by their original command and value objects. A pre-inference missing type is not a proof failure or evidence about the selected repair.
